```isabelle
theory RSF
  imports Complex_Main
begin

(* Reference for vector and matrix operations in Isabelle [web:6] *)

record rsf_layer_weights =
  s_weight :: "real list"
  t_weight :: "real list"
  s_bias :: "real list"
  t_bias :: "real list"

definition rsf_layer_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_weights" where
  "rsf_layer_init dim \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weight = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias = replicate dim 0 \<rparr>"

record rsf_layer_gradients =
  s_weight_grad :: "real list"
  t_weight_grad :: "real list"
  s_bias_grad :: "real list"
  t_bias_grad :: "real list"

definition rsf_gradients_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "rsf_gradients_init dim \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    t_weight_grad = replicate (dim * dim) 0,
    s_bias_grad = replicate dim 0,
    t_bias_grad = replicate dim 0 \<rparr>"

record rsf_layer_state =
  weights :: rsf_layer_weights
  gradients :: rsf_layer_gradients
  clip_min :: real
  clip_max :: real

definition rsf_layer_state_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state" where
  "rsf_layer_state_init dim cmin cmax \<equiv> \<lparr>
    weights = rsf_layer_init dim,
    gradients = rsf_gradients_init dim,
    clip_min = cmin,
    clip_max = cmax \<rparr>"

fun matrix_vector_mul :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "matrix_vector_mul rows cols mat vec =
    (if length mat = rows * cols \<and> length vec = cols
     then map (\<lambda>i. sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. mat ! (i * cols + j) * vec ! j) [0..<cols])) [0..<rows]
     else [])"

fun vector_add :: "real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "vector_add v1 v2 =
    (if length v1 = length v2
     then map (\<lambda>(x, y). x + y) (zip v1 v2)
     else [])"

fun vector_sub :: "real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "vector_sub v1 v2 =
    (if length v1 = length v2
     then map (\<lambda>(x, y). x - y) (zip v1 v2)
     else [])"

fun vector_mul :: "real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "vector_mul v1 v2 =
    (if length v1 = length v2
     then map (\<lambda>(x, y). x * y) (zip v1 v2)
     else [])"

fun vector_div :: "real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "vector_div v1 v2 =
    (if length v1 = length v2
     then map (\<lambda>(x, y). x / y) (zip v1 v2)
     else [])"

fun clamp_real :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "clamp_real x min_val max_val =
    (if x < min_val then min_val
     else if max_val < x then max_val
     else x)"

fun vector_clamp :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "vector_clamp min_val max_val vec = map (\<lambda>x. clamp_real x min_val max_val) vec"

fun vector_exp :: "real list \<Rightarrow> real list" where
  "vector_exp vec = map exp vec"

fun rsf_forward_scatter :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_forward_scatter dim st x1 x2 =
    (let w = weights st;
         s_out = matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2;
         s_bias_added = vector_add s_out (s_bias w);
         s_clamped = vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st) s_bias_added;
         s_exp = vector_exp s_clamped;
         y1 = vector_mul x1 s_exp
     in (y1, x2))"

fun rsf_forward_transform :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_forward_transform dim st x1 x2 =
    (let w = weights st;
         t_out = matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) x1;
         t_bias_added = vector_add t_out (t_bias w);
         y2 = vector_add x2 t_bias_added
     in (x1, y2))"

definition rsf_forward :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_forward dim st x1 x2 \<equiv>
    (let (y1_scatter, y2_scatter) = rsf_forward_scatter dim st x1 x2
     in rsf_forward_transform dim st y1_scatter y2_scatter)"

fun rsf_inverse_transform :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_inverse_transform dim st y1 y2 =
    (let w = weights st;
         t_out = matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1;
         t_bias_added = vector_add t_out (t_bias w);
         x2 = vector_sub y2 t_bias_added
     in (y1, x2))"

fun rsf_inverse_scatter :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_inverse_scatter dim st y1 y2 =
    (let w = weights st;
         s_out = matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) y2;
         s_bias_added = vector_add s_out (s_bias w);
         s_clamped = vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st) s_bias_added;
         s_exp = vector_exp s_clamped;
         x1 = vector_div y1 s_exp
     in (x1, y2))"

definition rsf_inverse :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_inverse dim st y1 y2 \<equiv>
    (let (x1_transform, x2_transform) = rsf_inverse_transform dim st y1 y2
     in rsf_inverse_scatter dim st x1_transform x2_transform)"

record rsf_network =
  layers :: "rsf_layer_state list"

definition rsf_network_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> rsf_network" where
  "rsf_network_init dim num_layers cmin cmax \<equiv> \<lparr>
    layers = replicate num_layers (rsf_layer_state_init dim cmin cmax) \<rparr>"

fun rsf_network_forward :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_network \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_network_forward dim net x1 x2 =
    (case layers net of
       [] \<Rightarrow> (x1, x2)
     | layer # rest \<Rightarrow>
         let (y1, y2) = rsf_forward dim layer x1 x2;
             rest_net = \<lparr> layers = rest \<rparr>
         in rsf_network_forward dim rest_net y1 y2)"

fun rsf_network_inverse_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_network_inverse_aux dim [] y1 y2 = (y1, y2)"
| "rsf_network_inverse_aux dim (layer # rest) y1 y2 =
     (let (x1', x2') = rsf_inverse dim layer y1 y2
      in rsf_network_inverse_aux dim rest x1' x2')"

definition rsf_network_inverse :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_network \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> (real list \<times> real list)" where
  "rsf_network_inverse dim net y1 y2 \<equiv>
     rsf_network_inverse_aux dim (rev (layers net)) y1 y2"

definition rsf_layer_wellformed :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_state \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "rsf_layer_wellformed dim st \<longleftrightarrow>
     length (s_weight (weights st)) = dim * dim \<and>
     length (t_weight (weights st)) = dim * dim \<and>
     length (s_bias (weights st)) = dim \<and>
     length (t_bias (weights st)) = dim"

lemma matrix_vector_mul_length:
  assumes "length mat = rows * cols" "length vec = cols"
  shows "length (matrix_vector_mul rows cols mat vec) = rows"
  using assms by simp

lemma vector_add_length:
  assumes "length v1 = n" "length v2 = n"
  shows "length (vector_add v1 v2) = n"
  using assms by simp

lemma vector_sub_length:
  assumes "length v1 = n" "length v2 = n"
  shows "length (vector_sub v1 v2) = n"
  using assms by simp

lemma vector_mul_length:
  assumes "length v1 = n" "length v2 = n"
  shows "length (vector_mul v1 v2) = n"
  using assms by simp

lemma vector_div_length:
  assumes "length v1 = n" "length v2 = n"
  shows "length (vector_div v1 v2) = n"
  using assms by simp

lemma vector_clamp_length:
  shows "length (vector_clamp a b v) = length v"
  by simp

lemma vector_exp_length:
  shows "length (vector_exp v) = length v"
  by simp

theorem rsf_layer_forward_shape:
  assumes "length x1 = dim" "length x2 = dim"
    "rsf_layer_wellformed dim st"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_forward dim st x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim \<and> length y2 = dim"
proof -
  obtain w where w_def: "w = weights st" by simp
  from assms(3) have wf:
    "length (s_weight w) = dim * dim"
    "length (t_weight w) = dim * dim"
    "length (s_bias w) = dim"
    "length (t_bias w) = dim"
    unfolding rsf_layer_wellformed_def w_def by auto
  have scat:
    "let (y1s, y2s) = rsf_forward_scatter dim st x1 x2
     in length y1s = dim \<and> length y2s = dim"
  proof -
    have "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2) = dim"
      using wf(1) assms(2) by (simp add: w_def matrix_vector_mul_length)
    then have len_s_out: "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2) = dim" .
    have "length (s_bias w) = dim" using wf(3) .
    then have "length (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2) (s_bias w)) = dim"
      using len_s_out by (simp add: vector_add_length)
    then have len_s_bias_added:
      "length (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2) (s_bias w)) = dim" .
    have len_s_clamped:
      "length (vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st)
               (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2) (s_bias w))) = dim"
      using len_s_bias_added by (simp add: vector_clamp_length)
    have len_s_exp:
      "length (vector_exp
               (vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st)
                 (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2) (s_bias w)))) = dim"
      using len_s_clamped by (simp add: vector_exp_length)
    have "length (vector_mul x1
             (vector_exp
               (vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st)
                 (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2) (s_bias w))))) = dim"
      using assms(1) len_s_exp by (simp add: vector_mul_length)
    then show ?thesis
      unfolding rsf_forward_scatter.simps w_def Let_def
      using assms(2) by simp
  qed
  then obtain y1s y2s where scat_len:
    "(y1s, y2s) = rsf_forward_scatter dim st x1 x2"
    "length y1s = dim" "length y2s = dim"
    by (cases "rsf_forward_scatter dim st x1 x2") auto
  then have "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1s) = dim"
    using wf(2) by (simp add: assms(1) scat_len(2) w_def matrix_vector_mul_length)
  then have len_t_out:
    "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1s) = dim" .
  have "length (t_bias w) = dim" using wf(4) .
  then have len_t_bias_added:
    "length (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1s) (t_bias w)) = dim"
    using len_t_out by (simp add: vector_add_length)
  have "length (vector_add y2s
           (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1s) (t_bias w))) = dim"
    using scat_len(3) len_t_bias_added by (simp add: vector_add_length)
  then show ?thesis
    unfolding rsf_forward_def Let_def rsf_forward_scatter.simps rsf_forward_transform.simps
    using scat_len(1) scat_len(2) scat_len(3) w_def by simp
qed

theorem rsf_layer_inverse_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim" "length y2 = dim"
    "rsf_layer_wellformed dim st"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_inverse dim st y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim \<and> length x2 = dim"
proof -
  obtain w where w_def: "w = weights st" by simp
  from assms(3) have wf:
    "length (s_weight w) = dim * dim"
    "length (t_weight w) = dim * dim"
    "length (s_bias w) = dim"
    "length (t_bias w) = dim"
    unfolding rsf_layer_wellformed_def w_def by auto
  have inv_t:
    "let (x1t, x2t) = rsf_inverse_transform dim st y1 y2
     in length x1t = dim \<and> length x2t = dim"
  proof -
    have "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1) = dim"
      using wf(2) assms(1) by (simp add: w_def matrix_vector_mul_length)
    then have len_t_out:
      "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1) = dim" .
    have "length (t_bias w) = dim" using wf(4) .
    then have len_t_bias_added:
      "length (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1) (t_bias w)) = dim"
      using len_t_out by (simp add: vector_add_length)
    have "length (vector_sub y2
             (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (t_weight w) y1) (t_bias w))) = dim"
      using assms(2) len_t_bias_added by (simp add: vector_sub_length)
    then show ?thesis
      unfolding rsf_inverse_transform.simps w_def Let_def by simp
  qed
  then obtain x1t x2t where inv_t_len:
    "(x1t, x2t) = rsf_inverse_transform dim st y1 y2"
    "length x1t = dim" "length x2t = dim"
    by (cases "rsf_inverse_transform dim st y1 y2") auto
  then have "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2t) = dim"
    using wf(1) by (simp add: assms(2) w_def matrix_vector_mul_length)
  then have len_s_out:
    "length (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2t) = dim" .
  have "length (s_bias w) = dim" using wf(3) .
  then have len_s_bias_added:
    "length (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2t) (s_bias w)) = dim"
    using len_s_out by (simp add: vector_add_length)
  have len_s_clamped:
    "length (vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st)
               (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2t) (s_bias w))) = dim"
    using len_s_bias_added by (simp add: vector_clamp_length)
  have len_s_exp:
    "length (vector_exp
               (vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st)
                 (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2t) (s_bias w)))) = dim"
    using len_s_clamped by (simp add: vector_exp_length)
  have "length (vector_div x1t
             (vector_exp
               (vector_clamp (clip_min st) (clip_max st)
                 (vector_add (matrix_vector_mul dim dim (s_weight w) x2t) (s_bias w))))) = dim"
    using inv_t_len(2) len_s_exp by (simp add: vector_div_length)
  then show ?thesis
    unfolding rsf_inverse_def Let_def rsf_inverse_transform.simps rsf_inverse_scatter.simps
    using inv_t_len(1) inv_t_len(2) inv_t_len(3) w_def by simp
qed

theorem rsf_network_forward_shape:
  assumes "length x1 = dim" "length x2 = dim"
    "\<forall>l \<in> set (layers net). rsf_layer_wellformed dim l"
  shows "let (y1, y2) = rsf_network_forward dim net x1 x2
         in length y1 = dim \<and> length y2 = dim"
  using assms
proof (induction "layers net" arbitrary: x1 x2 net)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons l ls)
  then obtain net' where net'_def: "net' = \<lparr> layers = ls \<rparr>" by simp
  from Cons.prems have wf_l: "rsf_layer_wellformed dim l"
    by (cases net) auto
  from Cons.prems have wf_ls: "\<forall>l' \<in> set ls. rsf_layer_wellformed dim l'"
    by (cases net) auto
  have scat:
    "let (y1, y2) = rsf_forward dim l x1 x2
     in length y1 = dim \<and> length y2 = dim"
    using rsf_layer_forward_shape[OF Cons.prems(1) Cons.prems(2) wf_l] by simp
  obtain y1 y2 where y_def:
    "(y1, y2) = rsf_forward dim l x1 x2"
    "length y1 = dim" "length y2 = dim"
    using scat by (cases "rsf_forward dim l x1 x2") auto
  have IH:
    "let (z1, z2) = rsf_network_forward dim net' y1 y2
     in length z1 = dim \<and> length z2 = dim"
    using Cons.IH[of net' y1 y2] wf_ls y_def(2) y_def(3) net'_def by simp
  show ?case
    unfolding rsf_network_forward.simps
    using y_def IH net'_def by simp
qed

theorem rsf_network_inverse_shape:
  assumes "length y1 = dim" "length y2 = dim"
    "\<forall>l \<in> set (layers net). rsf_layer_wellformed dim l"
  shows "let (x1, x2) = rsf_network_inverse dim net y1 y2
         in length x1 = dim \<and> length x2 = dim"
proof -
  have aux_shape:
    "\<And>ls a1 a2. length a1 = dim \<Longrightarrow> length a2 = dim \<Longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>l \<in> set ls. rsf_layer_wellformed dim l) \<Longrightarrow>
      let (b1, b2) = rsf_network_inverse_aux dim ls a1 a2
      in length b1 = dim \<and> length b2 = dim"
  proof (induction ls arbitrary: a1 a2)
    case Nil
    then show ?case by simp
  next
    case (Cons l ls)
    then have wf_l: "rsf_layer_wellformed dim l" by auto
    have inv_l:
      "let (x1t, x2t) = rsf_inverse dim l a1 a2
       in length x1t = dim \<and> length x2t = dim"
      using rsf_layer_inverse_shape[OF Cons.prems(1) Cons.prems(2) wf_l] by simp
    obtain x1t x2t where x_def:
      "(x1t, x2t) = rsf_inverse dim l a1 a2"
      "length x1t = dim" "length x2t = dim"
      using inv_l by (cases "rsf_inverse dim l a1 a2") auto
    have IH:
      "let (b1, b2) = rsf_network_inverse_aux dim ls x1t x2t
       in length b1 = dim \<and> length b2 = dim"
      using Cons.IH x_def(2) x_def(3) Cons.prems(3) by simp
    show ?case
      unfolding rsf_network_inverse_aux.simps
      using x_def IH by simp
  qed
  have wf_rev: "\<forall>l \<in> set (rev (layers net)). rsf_layer_wellformed dim l"
    using assms(2) by auto
  show ?thesis
    unfolding rsf_network_inverse_def Let_def
    using aux_shape[of "rev (layers net)" y1 y2] assms(1) assms(2) wf_rev by simp
qed

definition zero_gradients :: "rsf_layer_gradients \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "zero_gradients grads \<equiv> \<lparr>
    s_weight_grad = replicate (length (s_weight_grad grads)) 0,
    t_weight_grad = replicate (length (t_weight_grad grads)) 0,
    s_bias_grad = replicate (length (s_bias_grad grads)) 0,
    t_bias_grad = replicate (length (t_bias_grad grads)) 0 \<rparr>"

theorem zero_gradients_all_zero:
  "let zeroed = zero_gradients grads
   in (\<forall>i < length (s_weight_grad zeroed). s_weight_grad zeroed ! i = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < length (t_weight_grad zeroed). t_weight_grad zeroed ! i = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < length (s_bias_grad zeroed). s_bias_grad zeroed ! i = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < length (t_bias_grad zeroed). t_bias_grad zeroed ! i = 0)"
  by (simp add: zero_gradients_def)

end
```
